scope: Previously unseen primary H108 residues where direct same-coordinate copy predicts the opposite symbol from the raw compatible exact one-minority-per-physical-column family.
copy_method: For each target primary quarter, copy the single unanimously agreeing mark from its one or two observed same-depth/same-A-I coordinate peers in the other primary quarters; abstain on absent/conflicting peers.
column_method: For each primary 9-cell A-I frame, retain slash/dash completions with three minority marks and exactly one minority in each physical IAB/CDE/FGH column, respecting all physically observed marks.
reliability_warning: Cross-cube copying scored 22/33 leave-one-residue-out compared with 23/33 for majority, and 19/32 whole-cube-selected vs 21/32 baseline. These are frozen cross-family discriminators, not recommended high-confidence predictions.
prospective_test_protocol: Before viewing a new physical symbol, preserve this file unchanged and record the expected symbol under both operations; treat a column-rule contradiction as challenge to its grammar, not immediate proof of cube copying. Do not infer probabilities from 10/10 machine survivor counts.
